title: Initial state of the container two-pointer search
summary: Show the initial outer container at both ends as the baseline for comparing moving the taller wall versus moving the shorter wall.
context: To examine which pointer to move on ht = [3, 8, 5, 2, 7, 7, 3, 4], start with [i, j] = [0, 7] at the two ends as the baseline for comparing moving the taller wall inward versus moving the shorter wall inward.
description: Above index 0 sits left pointer i at height ht[0] = 3, and above index 7 sits right pointer j at height ht[7] = 4. With both end walls highlighted, a light-blue rectangle spanning indices 0 to 7 at height 3 (flush with left shorter wall 3) marks the current water region; below reads "i is the shorter wall; j is the taller wall" and "Current capacity: cap = min(3, 4) × (7 - 0) = 21".

frames.title: Initial state of the container two-pointer search
frames.explanation: Because left wall 3 is shorter than right wall 4, water height is capped at 3 across width 7 for capacity 21—the starting capacity rather than the array-wide maximum.
